articles.title: China ballistic missile test pushes case for Pacific security pact
articles.summary: Pacific Minister Pat Conroy stated that China's recent test launch of a nuclear-capable missile into the Pacific significantly damaged its regional standing. He argued this action has inadvertently strengthened the imperative for a robust regional security pact among nations. The incident raises concerns about escalating military activities and underscores the need for collective defence strategies in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: What To Watch This Weekend: New Shows And Movies To Stream On Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, Apple TV And More

Suggestions include futuristic sci-fi action featuring cyborg ninja assassins, intense crime dramas involving rival gangs, and epic fantasy narratives about powerful gods. articles.title: Wally Funk, Aviation Pioneer and Oldest Woman to Travel to Space, Dies at 87
articles.summary: Wally Funk, the aviation pioneer and oldest woman to journey into space, passed away at 87. A remarkable trailblazer, Funk was part of the 1960s Mercury 13 program, though gender discrimination prevented her from flying then. Decades later, at 82, she finally realized her lifelong dream aboard Blue Origin's New Shepard in 2021, inspiring countless individuals with her unwavering perseverance and breaking barriers in space exploration.

articles.title: The Vampire Lestat: Teaser For Sunday's Penultimate Episode Released; New Posters Spotlight Akasha & Marius
articles.summary: The latest episode of "The Vampire Lestat" officially introduced two immensely powerful vampires, Marius (Christopher Heyerdahl) and another key figure, to viewers. After being frequently mentioned, their on-screen debut significantly deepens the series' exploration of its rich mythological world and established power hierarchy, bringing central characters from the acclaimed literary source material to life.

articles.title: India becoming major railway products manufacturer and exporter: Ashwini Vaishnaw
articles.summary: Union Railways Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw visited the Medha Bogies Factory in Hyderabad, engaging with engineers and manufacturing teams. This interaction underscores the government's commitment to strengthening indigenous production capabilities in the railway sector. Such visits are vital for evaluating progress and fostering innovation in domestic manufacturing of critical railway components, aligning with national 'Make in India' initiatives for self-reliance and infrastructure development.

articles.title: Future wars will still be won by resolve and soldiers, not just AI: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, speaking in Visakhapatnam, stressed that while Artificial Intelligence may impact future conflicts, ultimate victory will hinge on national resolve, trained soldiers, and robust military power. He underscored the enduring importance of human courage and strategic strength over technological advancements alone, serving as a crucial insight for aspiring defence personnel.
